title: dimorphotheca pinnata
intro: Dimorphotheca pinnata, commonly known as the Star of Life or Cape Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to South Africa. It is known for its bright yellow and orange flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The plant has been associated with several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Dimorphotheca pinnata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
